lines.text: Namaste! I'm Dr. Kapil. ... In the next five minutes, you'll unlock three superpowers of your brain: speed, memory and focus. ... And you'll see the change with your own eyes. Let's begin!
First, let's see where you are today. ... There is no right or wrong here. ... Just relax, and do your natural best.
Your eyes usually jump back and forth while reading. ... Now the words will come to your eyes, one at a time. ... Just keep looking at the red letter in the middle.
Now, memory. ... Five words will appear, two seconds each. ... Remember as many as you can.
Here is the secret: your brain loves pictures and stories. ... Now we'll link five new words into one funny story. ... See each picture clearly in your mind.
A huge gorilla...
opens a giant suitcase.
Instead of clothes, curd pours out of the suitcase!
The curd soaks a flying drone...
and the heavy drone falls right into your tiffin.
A big green crocodile...
sits down and plays the piano.
Out of the piano jumps a giant burger!
The burger rides away on a skateboard...
and crashes right into a whistling cooker.
A sleepy panda...
puts on big headphones.
The music is so loud that ice cream shoots out of the headphones!
The ice cream lands on a tall crane...
and the crane drops it right into your sandal.
A smiling shark...
sings loudly into a microphone.
The microphone fills up with hot biryani!
The biryani is so spicy that it charges a battery...
and the battery flies off and puts on a funny mask!
A tiny lizard...
kicks a huge football.
The football bursts and popcorn rains everywhere!
The popcorn falls into a printer...
and the printer prints a giant lipstick.
A fluffy sheep...
drives a bullock cart.
The bullock cart is full of long, wiggly noodles!
The sheep eats all the noodles and wins a shiny medal...
and the medal starts singing like a loud speaker.
Last one, focus. ... Tap the numbers from one to sixteen, as fast as you can.
Now see the whole story once more in your mind.
Sit comfortably. ... Look softly at the glowing dot.
Breathe in.
And slowly breathe out.
Beautiful. ... Your mind is calm and sharp.
Wow! ... You just saw it yourself.
Great effort! ... In thirty days of practice, this grows step by step.
Here are your real numbers. ... Tap the green button, and I'll send your personal 30-day plan on WhatsApp.
